item.title: Despite Abbott endorsement, Sheets trails incumbent Miller in Agriculture Commissioner race
item.description: Despite an endorsement from Gov. Greg Abbott in his bid to unseat three-term incumbent Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller, Sheets is still significantly trailing in the latest poll.

item.title: 'Lives could've been lost'; Fire chief commends Bee Cave residents for help responding to apartment fire
item.description: Chief Robert B. Abbott of Lake Travis Fire Rescue made a presentation during the Feb. 10 council meeting, taking time to recognize what he said was "amazing work" of neighbors to assist the fire department with its response.

item.title: Humidity surges ahead of Saturday showers and storms
item.description: A low (1 out of 5) severe weather risk is in place for Saturday for all of Central Texas. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Hays County judge announces plans to call for moratorium on high-volume industrial water usage
item.description: The planned announcement will be February 16 at Spring Lake in San Marcos

item.title: UT combines cultural, gender, sexuality studies and merges several language departments
item.description: Several academic departments at the University of Texas at Austin will be combined, according to a Thursday announcement from UT President Jim Davis.

item.title: How much longer will you suffer from Cedar Fever?
item.description: Central Texas is entering a transition period as cedar pollen levels decline, but other pollens such as oak, elm, and pecan will soon be released, causing allergy sufferers to experience similar symptoms such as sneezing, congestion, and itchy eyes.

item.title: Longhorn Legend: Reese Atwood's record-setting blast helps Texas win home opener
item.description: Her only hit of the game was a towering blast over the left field wall at McCombs Field, helping the Longhorns run-rule the Wildcats 11-0 in the opening game of the Bevo Classic. It was the 59th homer of her career, lifting her above Taylor Hoagland's mark that stood since 2013. She has four home runs in six games so far this season.

item.title: 'We get your passion': Austin ISD asks students to stop anti-ICE walkouts in Instagram video
item.description: In an Instagram video posted on Wednesday, Austin Independent School District principals implored students to not move ahead with protests during the school day against immigration enforcement.

item.title: Kidnapping, death threat scams surface in Central Texas
item.description: A North Austin man says he was caught off guard when he received text messages and a video threatening his life and the lives of his family members.

item.title: Round Rock residents pack city hall as council votes on data center plan
item.description: Skybox Datacenters, a company that operates data center campuses across the U.S., wants to build a new data center facility on vacant land in Round Rock.
